items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Charlie Cardella. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, he was very good. He played with Abbott at the halfway house.

ctx.x: So I went to work in a restaurant. I didn't know anybody or anything. So I had to work 16 hours a day. So to work in a restaurant, I had a needle shot in my arm. The government kind of the soldiers. So this crazy noise breaks a needle off my arm. My arm swells up. So it finally got wet and I went in there. And that's where I learned how to haul a bowl of chili, a bowl of hell, and an oyster stew, a cemetery special. I learned all the waitresses things. I was getting $16 a week and all I could eat in 16 hours a…
For being an actor too. This personnel is right the way it's given here in the second line, Charlie Cardella.
Yeah, he was very good. He played with Abbott at the halfway house.
